text: {"lessons":["My account value fell from NT$104,088 to NT$96,539 while I made no trades; staying put did not prevent losses, so I should review whether my holdings still fit my risk tolerance.","These month-to-month price changes do not predict what comes next, so I should not sell simply because the recent trend is down.","Because losses weigh heavily on me and I trade infrequently, I should make calm, deliberate decisions based on my overall plan rather than react to short-term swings."]}
